findings.value: A contemporary art gallery on Three Colts Lane, Bethnal Green, which Plaster magazine says has been running since 2005. It has shown alongside Maureen Paley.

evidence.quote: Herald St has been flying the East London flag since 2005
Three Colts Lane is brimming with exciting new galleries and OG spaces including Herald St
shared across the spaces of both Maureen Paley and Herald St gallery

not_found: status (no closure or new-owner news found; herald-st.com could not be read (robots.txt unreachable), and the closing and new-owner searches were not run)
notes: herald-st.com refused (robots.txt unreachable), so the venue's own site and about page were not read; this file rests on two press pieces. The Plaster article is dated 2024-01-16 and the Art Newspaper piece 2024-09-16. The Art Newspaper describes a joint show of Maureen Paley and Herald St works.
